scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:01 - 00:00:03:22
YouTube has over 500 hours of video uploaded every minute.

00:00:04:07 - 00:00:07:06
Somewhere in there, a creator just featured your product

00:00:07:06 - 00:00:11:03
- and by the time you find it manually, it might already have 50,000 views.

00:00:11:13 - 00:00:15:00
That review could be glowing - and you missed the window to share it,

00:00:15:09 - 00:00:18:03
amplify it, or reach out to that creator.

00:00:18:03 - 00:00:21:23
Or it could be critical - and it's already shaping how thousands of people

00:00:21:23 - 00:00:24:20
think about your brand, while you're still in the dark.

00:00:24:20 - 00:00:26:02
Today I'm going to show you

00:00:26:02 - 00:00:29:23
how to use YouTube Scraper from Apify to build a fully automated brand

00:00:29:23 - 00:00:32:23
monitoring system that catches every mention,

00:00:32:23 - 00:00:36:06
surfaces influencer opportunities, and feeds your data

00:00:36:06 - 00:00:38:01
wherever you need it.

00:00:38:01 - 00:00:41:01
Head to Apify Store and search for YouTube Scraper.

00:00:41:02 - 00:00:44:10
Click "Try for free" to sign in or create a free account.

00:00:44:17 - 00:00:47:20
That takes you to Apify Console.

00:00:47:21 - 00:00:49:09
For input, you've got two options:

00:00:49:09 - 00:00:52:09
enter search terms or paste in direct URLs.

00:00:52:11 - 00:00:55:19
For brand monitoring, search terms are where you want to start.

00:00:56:05 - 00:00:59:19
Think about what creators would actually say in their titles and descriptions.

00:00:59:20 - 00:01:03:01
Let's say we're monitoring Nike. You'd add search terms

00:01:03:01 - 00:01:06:20
like "Nike review," "Nike Air Max," and maybe broader

00:01:06:20 - 00:01:09:24
keywords, like, "running shoe review" if that's your positioning.

00:01:10:14 - 00:01:13:06
You can add as many terms as you want.

00:01:13:06 - 00:01:15:18
The Actor runs them all in a single go.

00:01:15:18 - 00:01:19:24
Next, set your maximum results per search term. For ongoing monitoring,

00:01:19:24 - 00:01:22:24
a few hundred per term is usually more than enough.

00:01:23:00 - 00:01:24:19
Then there's date filtering -

00:01:24:19 - 00:01:28:23
and this is where it gets impressive for brand monitoring. Under "Add filters,"

00:01:28:23 - 00:01:33:02
you can sort by upload date, or use the date filter to pull only videos

00:01:33:02 - 00:01:36:22
from the last week, the last month, or even the last 24 hours.

00:01:36:22 - 00:01:39:06
For teams doing real-time monitoring,

00:01:39:06 - 00:01:43:14
setting that to "today" or "this week" keeps your dataset tight and relevant.

00:01:44:02 - 00:01:48:12
You can also filter by video type - regular videos, shorts, or streams -

00:01:48:12 - 00:01:52:05
so if you only care about long-form reviews, you can scope it down.

00:01:52:19 - 00:01:56:14
One more thing: if you want to monitor a specific creator's channel,

00:01:56:16 - 00:01:59:20
just paste their channel URL in the Direct URLs field.

00:01:59:21 - 00:02:03:04
That's useful if you've already identified key creators

00:02:03:04 - 00:02:06:04
in your space and want to track everything they put out.

00:02:06:14 - 00:02:09:21
Save your configuration as a task before you hit Start.

00:02:10:06 - 00:02:11:24
For when you want to come back to this.

00:02:13:01 - 00:02:13:13
Now that

00:02:13:13 - 00:02:17:08
you have the input set up, hit Start, and the Actor gets to work.

00:02:17:09 - 00:02:19:21
Results come in under the Overview tab.

00:02:19:21 - 00:02:23:00
For each video, you're getting the title, channel

00:02:23:10 - 00:02:28:11
name, video URL, view count, like count, comment count,

00:02:28:17 - 00:02:32:08
upload date, duration, hashtags, and description.

00:02:33:09 - 00:02:36:15
Engagement metrics are the pulse of your brand on YouTube.

00:02:36:18 - 00:02:41:22
There is a world of difference between a viral review racking up 50,000 views

00:02:42:00 - 00:02:45:13
and a small mention that falls flat with zero engagement.

00:02:46:04 - 00:02:49:11
We give you the hard numbers so you can prioritize the mentions

00:02:49:11 - 00:02:53:00
that actually move the needle. Once the run finishes,

00:02:53:01 - 00:02:54:09
click Export.

00:02:54:09 - 00:02:58:05
You can download as JSON, CSV, Excel, or XML.

00:02:58:14 - 00:03:02:10
For most brand monitoring work, CSV or Excel is easiest -

00:03:02:19 - 00:03:06:14
you can sort and filter immediately in whatever tool your team uses.

00:03:06:17 - 00:03:08:21
Beyond just tracking numbers, the data

00:03:08:21 - 00:03:12:10
you extract is in the perfect structured format for AI analysis.

00:03:12:17 - 00:03:16:16
You can feed these results into an LLM to automatically categorize

00:03:16:16 - 00:03:22:02
the sentiment of video titles, or identify the specific context of every mention -

00:03:22:18 - 00:03:25:23
whether it's a dedicated review, a quick shoutout,

00:03:26:08 - 00:03:29:04
or a comparison with a competitor.

00:03:29:04 - 00:03:33:03
You can let AI perform bulk tasks that used to take hours,

00:03:33:08 - 00:03:37:21
like clustering videos by sentiment, extracting the most common pain points

00:03:37:21 - 00:03:40:23
mentioned in descriptions, or generate keyword maps

00:03:40:23 - 00:03:44:01
to see which terms are most frequently paired with your brand.

00:03:44:10 - 00:03:48:24
Now that you've got your data, here's how to turn this into an always-on system.

00:03:49:17 - 00:03:53:15
Go to your task and set up a schedule - daily or weekly works well.

00:03:54:04 - 00:03:57:14
That gives you a rolling feed of new mentions as they appear,

00:03:57:19 - 00:04:01:08
so you're catching videos before they gain traction, not after.

00:04:01:23 - 00:04:04:17
From there, the Integrations tab connects you to

00:04:04:17 - 00:04:08:11
Google Sheets, Slack, Zapier, Make, and more.

00:04:08:14 - 00:04:10:07
Build a simple filter:

00:04:10:07 - 00:04:13:20
any video above a certain view count or engagement

00:04:14:00 - 00:04:17:02
threshold gets posted to a Slack channel automatically.

00:04:17:12 - 00:04:21:00
Your team sees new mentions without checking anything manually.

00:04:21:04 - 00:04:24:13
That same feed doubles as an influencer discovery pipeline.

00:04:24:21 - 00:04:28:14
When a creator organically features your brand, that's a partnership

00:04:28:14 - 00:04:32:00
signal. Filter for channels with solid engagement and relevant

00:04:32:00 - 00:04:35:09
content, and you've got a shortlist of creators to reach out to.

00:04:35:13 - 00:04:38:04
This is exactly how we use it at Apify.

00:04:38:04 - 00:04:40:24
We run a scheduled daily scrape that feeds into a Google Sheet

00:04:40:24 - 00:04:43:24
tracking organic mentions and affiliate content.

00:04:44:00 - 00:04:47:16
When something comes in with strong engagement, it hits a Slack channel.

00:04:47:23 - 00:04:51:20
This allows us to get inspiration for our own content and spot

00:04:51:20 - 00:04:55:14
affiliate-eligible creators as they emerge, not after the fact.

00:04:55:24 - 00:04:58:23
YouTube Scraper turns YouTube's massive creator ecosystem

00:04:58:23 - 00:05:01:17
from a blind spot into a structured data feed.

00:05:01:17 - 00:05:04:13
Instead of missing mentions or catching them too late,

00:05:04:13 - 00:05:06:10
you're working with real data -

00:05:06:10 - 00:05:08:07
every video, every engagement

00:05:08:07 - 00:05:11:07
signal, every new creator who's talking about your brand.

00:05:12:02 - 00:05:15:19
The link in the description takes you straight to the Actor. Apify's free

00:05:15:19 - 00:05:18:09
plan comes with $5 in monthly credits -

00:05:18:09 - 00:05:22:14
that's over 1,200 results a month without spending anything.

00:05:22:20 - 00:05:25:20
Enough to monitor several keywords, catch new mentions

00:05:25:20 - 00:05:28:20
as they appear, and decide whether you want to scale it up.

00:05:29:08 - 00:05:32:08
Set it up once, schedule it, and let it run.

00:05:32:12 - 00:05:35:12
Five minutes of setup for an always-on system.

00:05:36:01 - 00:05:38:14
If you want to go deeper on what you can do with YouTube

00:05:38:14 - 00:05:41:21
data, check out our full YouTube tutorial linked on screen.

00:05:41:22 - 00:05:45:20
If this was useful, give us a like and subscribe for more videos like this one.

00:05:45:24 - 00:05:49:05
Drop a comment if there's a use case you'd like to see covered next.

00:05:49:15 - 00:05:51:17
So long, and thanks for all the likes!
